name: DigiBuild Resilience
long_description:
Advanced materials and disaster intelligence for buildings and critical infrastructure.

Every building represents years of work. A home holds a family’s savings. A business supports livelihoods. Infrastructure keeps communities operating.

DigiBuild is expanding its work in construction technology to help protect those places.

We are bringing together protective-material development, storm intelligence and our experience working across the construction industry. Our initial focus is wildfire resilience and severe weather, with a longer-term opportunity to serve industrial facilities and critical infrastructure.

The industry leader in supply chain moves into Physical AI.
one_liner: Physical AI solutions that Protect What We Build.
